decisions.reason: The only definition repeats parsimonious without explaining unwillingness to spend; the intended meaning needs fuller evidence.
The eighteenth-century musical suite is unrelated to the business or travel suite context; the specialist homonym remains off-topic.
Pastry chef is a clear exact-headword occupational meaning; luxury establishments and superior pastry quality are not mandatory.
A member of the aristocracy is explicit; avoid the old implication that noble birth confers innate refinement.
A flat pathway-paving stone is clearly defined; it need not be manufactured, interlocking or brick-shaped.
No exact plural entry or reviewed pensioner identity mapping is available; age and pension eligibility should not be guessed.
The available five-part or time-period meanings do not explain the academic fin anchor; the intended connection and topic are unresolved.
The seasoning from the pepper plant's berry is explicit; avoid the candidate calling the whole peppercorn merely a seed and exclude legal consideration.
Very sharp or violent does not verify the proposed precise medical sudden-onset meaning; clearer clinical terminology evidence is needed.
Insight and sympathetic understanding give a self-contained meaning; instantaneous perception is not required.
Recurrence at regular intervals is fully explained and matches cycle without restricting the word to menstruation or mathematical functions.
Fluid movement through a permeable solid is precise science vocabulary; exclude business absorption and the separate disease-spreading sense.
Prolonging existence or keeping something active is explicit; the source does not require indefinite or permanent continuation.
No exact plural evidence or reviewed person mapping is available; the proposed legal-register guidance cannot supply the missing definition.
The source does not disambiguate spatial perspective from subjective viewpoint; it cannot verify the proposed editorial-writing comparison.
Clarity or lucidity of expression is explicitly supplied and relevant to clear business communication, unlike the rare transparency sense.
Applicability to the matter at hand is a complete explanation of relevance; no stronger logical precision is guaranteed.
Presence in all parts is explained by the source; this can describe a local system and does not necessarily mean worldwide.
Someone presenting a petition to a court is a clear legal-vocabulary meaning, without jurisdiction-specific procedural claims.
Studying drug use and effects across large populations is fully defined and directly relevant to academic epidemiology.
The adjective repeats pharmacology and the noun is an incomplete pointer; neither explains the intended drug-science meaning adequately.
Using pharmaceuticals to treat disease is explicit; no treatment recommendation or cancer-only definition of chemotherapy is approved.
The energy-storing phosphorylated creatine derivative in muscles is fully described and relevant to exercise physiology, without supplement claims.
The cached definition extends the category to phospholipid complexes, while the alternative is an incomplete adjective-like phrase; biochemical scope remains uncertain.
The source explicitly identifies a microscope plus camera, providing a concrete laboratory-instrument meaning relevant to microscope.
The definition only points to photons or photonics and does not explain the intended light-technology distinction; clearer factual wording is needed.
The source repeats photoprotective without explaining the protection; the old sunscreen claim cannot replace factual detail.
A neuron or other structure detecting and reacting to light is fully described and appropriately distinguishes this receptor type.
The clear candidate about a peculiar form of words does not verify the intended idiom or multi-word-unit sense; the other entry is circular.
The style of using words and phrases in speech or writing is explicit; it is not equivalent to the whole grammar of syntax.
The exact source gives piano and marks this term dated; retain that restriction rather than only calling it formal.
The arthropod grasping structure and hand tool do not establish a fitness claw context; do not promote the zoological homonym into exercise vocabulary.
The externally visible cartilaginous ear structure is explicitly defined; exclude the botanical leaf and other appendage senses.
Installing and maintaining industrial piping is a complete trade description; specific pressure levels or ship work are not required.
The rounded apple-variety meaning is explicit and suitable to food vocabulary; exclude the seed and dated admirable-person senses.
A small pizza is a complete culinary meaning; serving it as an appetizer is optional, not a definitional requirement.
Preserve the prior hold: adding for a goal still leaves placekick unexplained and does not independently verify the field-goal-versus-punt distinction.
Preserve the prior hold: English entries concern land maps or braiding, not the proposed French dining main-course meaning.
The only exact plural sense is number plates, not the intended book illustrations; do not publish the wrong object category.
A violent or dramatic fall is a clear noun meaning; do not mislabel it as the adjective descendent or imply every fall is numerical.
